# infisical_sso_settings (Resource)

Manage the SSO enforcement settings of the organization. An organization has one set of these settings, and they belong to the organization of the machine identity. Destroying this resource sets every setting back to its default. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource, and only for a root organization: sub-organizations cannot manage SSO.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

# Infisical accepts enforce_sso = true only after someone has logged in through the active SSO configuration.
# Apply with enforce_sso = false first, log in once through your identity provider, then set it to true.
resource "infisical_sso_settings" "example" {
  enforce_sso              = true
  admin_sso_bypass_enabled = true
  sso_mfa_trust            = "signal"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_sso_bypass_enabled` (Boolean) Whether organization admins can still log in with a password at `/login/admin` while SSO is enforced. Defaults to `false`.
- `enforce_google_sso` (Boolean) Whether members must log in with Google. Infisical accepts `true` only after someone has logged in with Google, and only while no SAML, OIDC or LDAP configuration is active. Cannot be `true` together with `enforce_sso`. Defaults to `false`.
- `enforce_sso` (Boolean) Whether members must log in through the organization's SAML or OIDC provider. Infisical accepts `true` only after someone has logged in through the active SAML or OIDC configuration, so a new configuration needs a login and a second apply. A change to the connection settings of the OIDC configuration (for example `client_id` in `infisical_sso_oidc`) turns enforcement off in Infisical, and the next plan shows the change. Cannot be `true` together with `enforce_google_sso`. Defaults to `false`.
- `sso_mfa_trust` (String) Whether MFA done at the identity provider satisfies the organization's MFA requirement. One of `none` or `signal`. Has no effect unless MFA is enforced. Defaults to `none`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the organization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the SSO settings by the ID of the organization.
terraform import infisical_sso_settings.example <organization_id>
```
